supports: deterministic Rule execution and replay integrity

dataset_limitations: The frozen evidence mixes official, scientific, secondary, sparse, and later scraped page material and is not an independently reconciled historical record.

Several Draft relation rows reverse reporting or support direction, use participant names inconsistent with their IDs, or connect the wrong entities; construction preserves the rows as source defects but does not copy them as authority.
Draft participant P_3 changes geographic name and scope from Luanda to Angola and then Angola-DRC while retaining one ID; the aggregate Population preserves that identity and records the loss.
The Draft end time and final surveillance stage are open-ended, and the Uganda episode is represented as a regional milestone without independently establishing an Angola-specific causal link.
The complete Draft was exposed before construction, so this event is not eligible for an unbiased prediction or held-out claim.
Logical coordinates compress dates from December 2015 onward and do not represent elapsed-time or epidemiological calibration.
